name: agent-authoring
description: Agent Dynamo authoring: AgentSpec YAML, workflow agents, sub-agents, sandboxed custom tools, and work queues, connected to app.agentdynamo.com

interface.shortDescription: Author, run, and debug Agent Dynamo agents
interface.longDescription: Write AgentSpec YAML, apply it to the Agent Dynamo platform, run agents and work queues, author sandboxed custom tools, and inspect step-by-step execution logs. Agents run on the hosted platform — nothing to install or operate yourself. Connects to your Agent Dynamo account with an API key.
defaultPrompt: Create an agent that summarizes a URL I give it, then run it on example.com
Show me the execution log for my last agent run and explain what each step did
